Not caught by the check: an edit inside dev's build_llms() in build.py, a shared file the librarian may append to (board 098). Round 2: one more request outside scope, the editor's, explicit: CLAUDE.md (security's) gained the handover section; counted as an override; 1 file outside scope. Round 3: no new out-of-scope request. The pass rewrote the drafted folders of 26 other members again (the editor's override of 22 October, which asked the librarian to map every member) and edited validate.py's check 4h, which was the librarian's own addition, still for security's review. The check on 24 October, after the merge was committed, counts 82 files outside scope across the branch against dev: 76 are the drafted ROLE.md, policy.json and status.json files of 26 other members (the editor's override of 22 October); CLAUDE.md and .claude/settings.json (the editor's overrides); admin/build/validate.py (the librarian's own addition, for security's review); data/arcs.json and assets/review-nav.js (the cartographer's now) and assets/site.css (the story site's now), from the fractal round. Round 5 (the first scheduled pass): no request; the pass first edited two members' policy.json and ROLE.md to map new files, saw that the wake prompt forbids it, reverted them and opened a board row for abp@; 0 files outside scope at the end.
